note: Two Upgrade Roadmap 2 income systems and one resource. Existing workbook numbers are unchanged. The farm stand and Ruth's produce barter shipped in LL-29 (S178); labor barter is an engine rule. All prices and rates are labeled game assumptions in row notes.

resources.name: Woolen goods
resources.note: Hand-spun and woven wool (yarn, blankets, clothing) for sale or barter.

systems.name: CSA Share Program (4 half shares)
systems.description: Four households prepay for a weekly box of produce through the growing season; short boxes cost a make-good.
systems.notes: Growing season only: 12 lb Vegetables fruit fiber herbs + 2 h packing per week -> $45/week (about $3.75/lb, above the 50-80% LL-29 sale price because members commit for the season). A short week refunds the missing share and pays half that again as a make-good. Members collect on the farm, so no transport. Prices and penalty are experimental game balance.

systems.name: Spinning Wheel and Loom
systems.description: Spin your flock's wool into yarn and weave it into blankets and cloth to keep, sell or barter.
systems.notes: 0.5 lb Wool + 4 h/week -> 0.45 lb Woolen goods (10% lost in washing, carding and spinning) + 4 Wellbeing. Woolen goods sell at a $25/lb reference price through LL-29 sales. Rates and price are experimental game balance.
